sections.title: Cryptography
sections.description: This course is an introduction to cryptography, both theory and applications, intended for advanced undergraduates and graduate students. Topics covered include symmetric cryptography, message authentication, public-key cryptography, digital signatures, cryptanalysis, cryptographic security, and secure channels, as well as a selection of more advanced topics such as zero-knowledge proofs, secure multiparty computation, privacy-enhancing technologies, or lattice-based cryptography.
